name: Submit Juice

sources.title: Homepage — done-for-you startup directory submission service; pricing tiers Classic $197 / Premium $297 / Premium Plus $983, plus a $0 DIY tier with their 152+ directory list

requirements: Free 'DIY' tier: access to their list of 152+ directories for self-submission at $0
Paid tiers are a service, not a listing: Classic $197 (submits to ~20 directories), Premium $297 (~50 directories, DA 20+ guarantee), Premium Plus $983 (works until DA 40+, SaaS/software only)
Service is for software startups (SaaS, no-code, etc.); recently extended to local businesses; no illegal/NSFW/alcohol/weapons/drugs
Submissions are manual by their team over 5–7 days; coverage is NOT guaranteed — 'we can only guarantee our submissions'
preparation: For DIY: just grab the free directory list (airtable) and submit yourself
For paid: budget, a completed onboarding questionnaire, your pitch copy, and approval of their generated target-site list
Optional add-ons: Press Bundle (+$293, AP News/FOX/etc. syndication) and Graphics Bundle (+$298)
workflow: Free path: open the site, take the 'View now' DIY option to get the 152+ directories list and track submissions yourself in their Airtable
Paid path: buy a package, complete the questionnaire, review/approve their custom site list, they manually submit over ~a week
You receive a listing report with links to live listings in a personal Airtable
watchFor: This is a service, not a destination — your product doesn't get 'listed on submitjuice'; they submit elsewhere for you
Urgency marketing: 'raising prices this week', discount codes (ENDOFSUMMER for $100 off) — verify current pricing
DA guarantees are only on Premium tiers and apply to software sites
Press-bundle pickups 'depend on the nature of the news' — paid syndication networks, not earned coverage
Refund logic is 'pay nothing' only on the DA guarantee tiers; base service is delivered once proof of submission is provided
countsAsLive: Not a listing site — success is the Airtable submission report showing live third-party listings (verify each claimed link)
unknowns: Quality/exact contents of the 152+ directory list without signing up
Whether the free Airtable requires account creation
Actual listing acceptance rate across the directories they submit to
